div.head: II Cn 4.1
div.ab: And we beodað, þæt wiðersacan ⁊ utlagan Godes ⁊ manna of eardæ gewitan, butan hig gebugan ⁊ þe geornor gebetan.
And we beodað, þæt wiðersacan ⁊ utlagan Godes ⁊ manna of earde gewitan, buton hig gebugan ⁊ þe geornar betan.
And witena gerædnes is, þæt wiðersacan ⁊ utlagan Godes ⁊ manna of earde gewitan, buton hi gebugon ⁊ þe geornor gebetan.
Precipimus etiam, ut þiþersacan (apostate) et útlage Dei et hominum patriam exeant, nisi (si non) resipuerint et digne peniteant.
We beodað þæt wiðersacan ⁊ útlagan Godes ⁊ manna of earde gewítan, buton hig gebúgan ⁊ ðe geornor gebétan.
And we beodað þæt wiðersacan and utlagan Godes and manna of eardæ gewitan butan hig gebugan and þe geornor gebetan.
Und wir gebieten (Beschluss der Witan ist D), dass [kirchlich] Abtrünnige und von Kirche und Menschen Geächtete aus dem Lande weichen, es sei denn, sie unterwerfen sich und büssen um so eifriger.
And we command (it is the decision of the witan, D) that apostates and outlaws of God and men depart from the land, unless they submit and atone all the more eagerly.
We enjoin that apostates and those who are cast out from the fellowship of God and of men shall depart from the land, unless they submit and make amends to the utmost of their ability.
And we command that apostates and those in defiance of the laws of God and the realm are to leave this land unless they submit and most sincerely repent.
